message.entry: ContinuationPowerFlow(net, Name, Value) is removed: the solver no longer holds the network or its result, and ContinuationPowerFlow() takes no arguments. Use [result, flag] = net.calculate_continuation_powerflow(LoadBus=...) (defaults in net.solver_CPF), or the deprecated wrapper Continuation_Power_Flow(net, opt) for the v3 usage.
